Contracts for AwadyLab.EFCatalyst: entity interfaces (IEntity, ISoftDelete, audit, tenant, row version, active state, integrity hash), domain events, global filters, migration seeders and the service abstractions an application implements.

Entity Framework Core toolkit: auditable/soft-deletable/multi-tenant entity bases, named global query filters, conditional and keyset-paging LINQ extensions, SaveChanges interceptors, model conventions, column encryption, shadow-property helpers, change-tracking audit logs and migration utilities.

SQL Server support for AwadyLab.EFCatalyst: native rowversion concurrency, deadlock detection and T-SQL generation for the EFCatalyst migration operations (views, upserts, soft-delete and timestamp triggers, filtered indexes).

PostgreSQL (Npgsql) support for AwadyLab.EFCatalyst: deadlock detection and SQL generation for the EFCatalyst migration operations (views, functions, ON CONFLICT upserts, soft-delete and timestamp triggers, filtered indexes).

SQLite support for AwadyLab.EFCatalyst: sortable DateTimeOffset storage, busy/locked detection and SQL generation for the EFCatalyst migration operations (views, upserts, soft-delete and timestamp triggers, filtered indexes).
